memphis-horrorcore.name: Memphis horrorcore
memphis-horrorcore.notes: 808 cowbell rolls, triplet hats, kick on 1 and the 'and' of 3

phonk.name: Phonk / drift phonk
phonk.notes: half-time at drift tempo (kick 1, snare 3), cowbell on the melody, hat sixteenths

dark-trap.name: Dark trap / horror trap
dark-trap.notes: snare on 3, 808 glides on the 'and' before 1, hat rolls 1/32

rage.name: Rage / opium
rage.notes: fewer hat rolls than trap, 808 pattern is the main rhythm, snare on 3

plugg.name: Plugg / pluggnb
plugg.notes: bouncy 808 with lots of space, hats in bursts, soft rim snare

cloud-rap.name: Cloud rap / Sad Boys
cloud-rap.notes: soft half-time, few hats, claps drenched in reverb; early cloud is slow boom bap

experimental-hip-hop.name: Experimental / industrial hip hop
experimental-hip-hop.notes: drums stutter, drop out, double; blast-beat bursts; sample chops off-grid

abstract-hip-hop.name: Abstract / underground boom bap
abstract-hip-hop.notes: late snares, MPC swing 58-66%, drumless or kick-only sections

uk-drill.name: UK drill / NY drill
uk-drill.notes: kick 1, 'a' of 2 and the 'and' of 3 (3-3-2 feel); snare on 3 and the 'a' of 4; 808 slides mid-bar; triplet hat bursts

trap-metal.name: Trap metal / scream rap
trap-metal.notes: half-time trap that breaks into double-time or blast-beat sections; breakdown stops

sigilkore.name: Sigilkore / hexD / digicore
sigilkore.notes: hats degraded into noise bursts, stutter/retrigger edits, random drop-outs

chopped-screwed.name: Chopped & screwed / trillwave
chopped-screwed.notes: repeat a beat ('chop'), stutter the downbeat, drag the tempo

witch-house.name: Witch house
witch-house.notes: screwed Southern-rap drums: slow 808 kick, clap on 3, rattling hats pitched down

electroclash-crystal.name: Electroclash / noise-pop (Crystal Castles line)
electroclash-crystal.notes: four-on-the-floor or driving eighths, gated noise snares, drum-machine fills that glitch

industrial-techno.name: Industrial techno / hard techno
industrial-techno.notes: four-on-the-floor kick with 'rumble' tail, off-beat open hat, 16th-note percussion loops, no snare or a clap on 2 and 4

minimal-dub-techno.name: Minimal / dub techno
minimal-dub-techno.notes: soft four-on-the-floor, off-beat hats, dub delay on claps, shuffled 16th ghost hats

acid.name: Acid house / acid techno
acid.notes: four-on-the-floor, off-beat open hat, 303 16th pattern with accents and slides on odd steps, 909 clap 2 and 4

ebm-darkwave.name: EBM / darkwave / coldwave
ebm-darkwave.notes: bass sequencer in 16ths, drum machine kick on every beat or 1 and 3, snare 2 and 4, tom fills, little swing

gabber-hardcore.name: Gabber / hardcore / terrorcore
gabber-hardcore.notes: kick on every beat (the distorted kick IS the bass), off-beat hat, snare rolls into drops, occasional triplet kicks

breakcore-digital-hardcore.name: Breakcore / digital hardcore
breakcore-digital-hardcore.notes: Amen break chopped per 1/32, gabber kick bursts, time-signature jumps (7/8, 5/4), snare rushes, silence drops

jungle-dnb.name: Jungle / dark drum & bass
jungle-dnb.notes: two-step: kick 1, snare 2 and 4 with ghost kicks on the 'a' of 2; Amen/Think chops; halftime D&B drops the snare to 3

dubstep-deep.name: Dubstep (deep / early UK)
dubstep-deep.notes: kick 1, snare 3; kick patterns in 3-3-2; shuffled 2-step hats; lots of space; Burial: off-grid, swung, crackly

uk-garage-2step.name: UK garage / 2-step / UK bass
uk-garage-2step.notes: 2-step: kick 1 and the 'and' of 2 (no kick on 3), snare 2 and 4, shuffled 16th hats with swing 60%+; grime: 8-bar switch-ups, square-wave stabs on 3-3-2

footwork-juke.name: Footwork / juke / ghetto house
footwork-juke.notes: 808 toms in triplets against straight claps, kick in 3-3-2 then shifted, snare rolls, vocal sample as a drum; polyrhythm 3 vs 4

jersey-baile-gqom.name: Jersey club / baile funk / gqom (global bass)
jersey-baile-gqom.notes: Jersey: kick on 1, 'a' of 2, 'and' of 3, then two 8ths (the 'triplet'); baile funk: tamborzão 3-3-2 toms at 130; gqom: broken 4/4, kick drops out, 3-3-2 toms; amapiano: log drum 3-3-2 at 112

deconstructed-club.name: Deconstructed club / post-club
deconstructed-club.notes: patterns start then collapse; dembow or ballroom 'ha' crash as fragments; silence and rubato; sound-design hits replace drums

idm-glitch.name: IDM / glitch / braindance
idm-glitch.notes: programmed breaks shifted by 1/64, polymetric hats, generative patterns, glitch clicks as hats; BoC uses slow lo-fi boom bap

chiptune.name: Chiptune / 8-bit
chiptune.notes: noise-channel kick/snare, 16th arps, 8-bit drum fills, occasional breakcore chip

dark-psytrance.name: Dark psytrance / hi-tech
dark-psytrance.notes: kick on every beat, bass on the 16ths between kicks (off-beat triplet rolling bass), hats 1/16, no snare

hardstyle-rawstyle.name: Hardstyle / rawstyle
hardstyle-rawstyle.notes: kick on every beat with reverse bass on the off-beats, triplet kick fills, screeches on 2 and 4

darksynth-synthwave.name: Darksynth / synthwave
darksynth-synthwave.notes: LinnDrum kick 1 and 3, gated snare 2 and 4, 16th arps, tom fills; techno side four-on-the-floor

vaporwave-hauntology.name: Vaporwave / hauntology / hypnagogic
vaporwave-hauntology.notes: slowed 80s drum machine, boom-bap at 70, or no drums; hauntology: brushed loops with tape skips

trip-hop.name: Trip hop / Bristol
trip-hop.notes: slow swung breaks, heavy snare on 2 and 4 behind the beat, vinyl loops, brushed hats

lofi-beats.name: Lo-fi hip hop / beat scene
lofi-beats.notes: Dilla feel: kicks ahead, snares late, hats swung and uneven; FlyLo: polyrhythms, drunk drums, dropped beats

industrial.name: Industrial / post-industrial
industrial.notes: mechanical 8th/16th kick patterns, metal-on-metal percussion, drum-machine military snare, stop-start; NIN: live kit + machine

noise-power-electronics.name: Noise / harsh noise / power electronics
noise-power-electronics.notes: no pulse, or a slow death-industrial thud every bar; bursts and silences; feedback swells

dark-ambient-drone.name: Dark ambient / drone
dark-ambient-drone.notes: no pulse or a very slow one (a hit every 2-4 bars); swells instead of beats; the drum thread's 'Free' rhythm

dungeon-synth.name: Dungeon synth
dungeon-synth.notes: no drums, or slow timpani/frame drum on 1 and 3; marches; 3/4 and 6/8 dances

ambient-experimental.name: Ambient / experimental electronic (modern)
ambient-experimental.notes: none, or sequencer 16ths without drums, or dubby broken loops (Actress, Stott) with kicks pushed off the grid

post-punk.name: Post-punk (classic + revival)
post-punk.notes: tom-driven tribal beats (Banshees, Bauhaus), motorik 8ths, disco-ish hi-hat on the off, dance-punk 16ths

no-wave-noise-rock.name: No wave / noise rock
no-wave-noise-rock.notes: pounding quarter-note toms (Swans), drum-machine stiffness (Big Black), chaotic double-time (Lightning Bolt); odd meters

shoegaze-dreampop.name: Shoegaze / dream pop / nu-gaze
shoegaze-dreampop.notes: steady 8th hats, kick 1 and 3, snare 2 and 4 soaked in reverb; dream pop uses drum machines at 80; blackgaze blasts at 180

slowcore-sadcore.name: Slowcore / sadcore
slowcore-sadcore.notes: brushes, snare on 3 only, or kick-snare every two beats; sometimes no drums; 6/8 waltzes

post-rock.name: Post-rock / post-metal
post-rock.notes: builds from no drums → rimshot quarters → full kit 8ths → crash on every beat; 6/8 and 7/4 common (Slint, Tool-adjacent)

krautrock-psych.name: Krautrock / psych / space rock
krautrock-psych.notes: motorik: kick 1-2-3-4 with 8th hats and snare 2/4, no fills; Can: funky 16th hi-hat grooves (Jaki Liebezeit); space rock: driving 8ths

math-rock-emo.name: Math rock / midwest emo / screamo
math-rock-emo.notes: odd meters (7/8, 5/4, 11/8), polymetric guitar vs drums, start-stop; screamo: blast beats and D-beats into clean quiet parts

hardcore-punk-extreme.name: Hardcore punk / powerviolence / grind
hardcore-punk-extreme.notes: D-beat (kick-snare gallop), blast beat (kick+snare alternating 16ths), skank beat, breakdown half-time with china; tempo jumps every 8 bars

black-metal.name: Black metal (raw, atmospheric, Nordic)
black-metal.notes: blast beats (kick-snare 16ths), tremolo over 'skank' beats, slow doomy halves; atmospheric: 8ths with crash on every beat for minutes

doom-sludge.name: Doom / sludge / stoner
doom-sludge.notes: kick 1, snare 3 at 50 bpm (giant half-time), crash on 1 only, triplet swing shuffles (stoner), funeral: one hit per bar

death-metal-swedish.name: Death metal (Swedish / cavernous / tech)
death-metal-swedish.notes: D-beat (Stockholm), blasts, double-kick 16ths under half-time snare, breakdown half-time with china; tech: odd meters, polyrhythms

industrial-metal-nu.name: Industrial metal / nu-metal (dark side)
industrial-metal-nu.notes: hip-hop-derived kick syncopation under rock snare 2/4 (nu-metal), machine-tight 16th kicks (industrial), breakdowns, DJ scratches

free-spiritual-jazz.name: Free jazz / spiritual jazz
free-spiritual-jazz.notes: swing ride at any tempo, free pulse ('energy music'), African 6/8 bells (spiritual), rubato; drums as colour not time

musique-concrete-electroacoustic.name: Musique concrète / electroacoustic / sound art
musique-concrete-electroacoustic.notes: no metre; gestures, swells, cuts; rhythm from repetition of found sounds (loops of a door, a train)

dark-modern-classical.name: Dark modern classical / minimalism
dark-modern-classical.notes: no drums; pulse from piano ostinati (Glass 16ths, Richter 8ths), string tremolo; 3/4 and 5/4; rubato swells

art-pop-experimental.name: Art pop / experimental pop
art-pop-experimental.notes: programmed broken beats, 2-step, trap half-time under pop melodies, silence drops; twigs: micro-stutters; Björk: timpani and glitch

hyperpop.name: Hyperpop / bubblegum bass
hyperpop.notes: switches every 8 bars: four-on-the-floor → trap half-time → pop-punk 8ths → breakcore burst; stutter edits as fills

goth-ethereal.name: Goth rock / ethereal / dark cabaret
goth-ethereal.notes: drum machine 'Doktor Avalanche' 8ths (Sisters), tribal tom patterns, slow 3/4 waltzes (cabaret), funeral halves

freak-folk-psych-folk.name: Freak folk / psych folk / neofolk
freak-folk-psych-folk.notes: hand percussion, no drums, 3/4 and 6/8 folk dances, martial snare marches (neofolk), rubato

swedish-underground.name: Swedish underground (map)
swedish-underground.notes: cloud-rap half-time; The Knife's broken electro; Viagra Boys' motorik; Swedish drill 3-3-2 kicks; metal blasts and D-beats

nordic-dark-electronic.name: Nordic dark electronic / Scandinavian noir
nordic-dark-electronic.notes: slow four-on-the-floor with ticking hats, broken electro, dubby off-beats, tom patterns (Fever Ray)

travis-scott-psych-trap.name: Psychedelic trap (Travis Scott line)
travis-scott-psych-trap.notes: snare 3, 808 slides, hat rolls, beat switch to a slower half-time or a faster double-time section
